During the early stages of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], this '''raid''' was conducted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on [[Spaceport THX1138]], a spaceport used by the travel agencies of the [[Galactic Tourist Bureau/Legends|Galactic Tourist Bureau]], including [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]], located at the [[Earth system]]. The raid was conducted because a [[Unidentified Rebel spy|Rebel spy]] was detected on one of Star Tours' [[StarSpeeder 1000]]s.<ref name="STAC" />

==Prelude==
Around [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] was officially declared, with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] unwittingly unleashing it on the galaxy.<ref name="encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> At least one year later,<ref name="Convenient Daily Departures" /> [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] Captain and secret Rebel Alliance member [[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Raymus Antilles]] arranged to ship [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] to the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] intergalactic travel agency to ensure the successful expansion of its operations. This move led the Galactic Empire to suspect that the travel agency was a Rebel front.<ref name="STAC" />

==The raid==
[[File:Star_Tours_space_station.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Imperial starships raid the station]]
Sometime later, around 0700 hours<ref name="ST2 viewscreen">The [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours ]]departures list, in which every flight listed as "boarding," "landing," or "on approach" is set to leave shortly after 0700 hours</ref> one morning, a [[Unidentified Rebel spy|Rebel spy]] boarded the StarSpeeder 1000 for [[Star Tours Flight 1401]] (ST-1401) among various civilian passengers. Due to a last-minute mix-up, [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] C-3PO inadvertently replaced [[AC-38/Legends|AC-38]] as the pilot via getting trapped in the cockpit by the autopilot when he is about to do maintenance in there. Learning of the spy's location, the Galactic Empire dispatched a fleet composed of several [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] and several TIE fighters to surround Spaceport THX1138. Imperial agents including a contingent of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], under [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] orders,<ref name="Convenient Daily Departures" /> boarded the station and identified one of the passengers as the Rebel spy just before the speeder's departure. When they attempted to stop the ship (which has C-3PO in it) and board it, astromech R2-D2 opened fire with the ship's blasters and took off, firing on Imperial ships before escaping into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] with the Rebel spy.<ref name="STAC" /> Prior to its escape, however, Vader had hired the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] to retrieve the vessel in case it escaped.<ref name="Convenient Daily Departures" />

==Behind the scenes==
This article is based on the beginning of the ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' ride. The ride randomly chooses one of two conflicting sequences of events.

One possibility is that ST-1401 is cleared for takeoff, only for several dozen stormtroopers, four [[Jumptrooper/Legends|skytroopers]], four TIE/LN starfighters, and Darth Vader (riding on a [[Hover Platform]]) to descend on the runway and force ST-1401 to stop. After Vader reveals that a Rebel spy is aboard and declares the spy's arrest, ST-1401 attempts to escape by backing out. However, Vader stops it and attempts to reel it in via [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. R2-D2, however, activates the StarSpeeder 1000's weapons systems and fires them at Vader. Vader is forced to release the vessel from his grip in order to deflect the cannon blasts with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], with the stormtroopers proceeding to fire at the escaping vessel and the TIEs taking off in pursuit. R2-D2 then destroys one of the TIEs upon escape, forcing the other three to scatter, before taking off into hyperspace.

Another possibility is that ST-1401 is scanned by an [[Unidentified Prowler 1000 seeker droid|Prowler 1000 exploration droid]] before it can clear departure regulations. In addition, then-smuggler [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], whose ship, the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], is docked next to the StarSpeeder 1000, has a run-in with stormtroopers that were presumably deployed to capture ST-1401. Afterwards, both the ''Millennium Falcon'' and ST-1401 escape the station, with ST-1401 on the ''Falcon''{{'s}} tail while evading Imperial ships, and the ''Falcon'' aiding ST-1401 in escaping. The ''Falcon'' eventually attacks one of the Star Destroyers, severely damaging it, thus allowing the StarSpeeder 1000 to escape from the Imperials into hyperspace.

Although the [[StarWars.com]] blog entry "[[Convenient Daily Departures: The History of Star Tours]]" confirmed Vader's involvement in the raid, it did not specify whether Vader had personally led the troops in attempting to halt ST-1401.<ref name="Convenient Daily Departures" /> As such, the article is written with events from both scenarios.

When [[sequel trilogy]] content was added to the attraction in 2017 to promote the release of [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''The Last Jedi'']] and allow an earlier [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''The Force Awakens'']] update to exist separately from the original 2011 material, reshot versions of the raid scenes featuring [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]] and [[First Order stormtrooper]]s in place of Imperial counterparts were added. Other than these visual and audio changes, the events are basically identical.
